reason: The patch adds GROUPS to the schema and to `getOrCreateResource` (server-spi-private/src/main/java/org/keycloak/authorization/AdminPermissionsSchema.java:79,109), but `getResourceName` at AdminPermissionsSchema.java:328-350 still only special-cases USERS, so group resources and the "Groups" type resource fall through to `resource.getDisplayName()`. That display name is never set for them (created at AdminPermissionsSchema.java:121 and :273), so PolicyResourceService.java:218 returns null and there is no "All groups" label.
